items.label: Round cog
items.fact: Even teeth all around — fold it any way through the middle and it matches!

items.label: Butterfly plate
items.fact: One wing mirrors the other — a perfect line of symmetry down the middle.

items.label: Six-tooth cog
items.fact: Symmetrical cogs run smoothly — balance stops the wobble!

items.label: Lopsided cog
items.fact: That extra lump means NO fold line matches — it would wobble terribly.

items.label: Bent lever
items.fact: Bent out of shape — no mirror halves here.

items.label: Snail spring
items.fact: Spirals curl one way only — flip it and it looks different. Not symmetrical!
